A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an output feedback control methodology for the singularly perturbed system which is applicable to a wide class of systems, including those arising in the control of flexible structures, and which is less restrictive in terms of controller design and robustness with respect to singularly perturbations than previous approaches.

we have shown that, in the case of singularly perturbations due to fast actuators and sensors, the output feedback controller designed for the reduced order system can be applied to the full order system and the resulting closed loop system will be exponentially stable for sufficiently slow perturbations.
we have developed a systematic approach for the design of robust output feedback controllers for singularly perturbed linear systems, based on the use of a singular perturbation approximation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in the presence of singular perturbations, it may not be sufficient to design a controller for the reduced order system and then use this controller to stabilize the full order system.
